documents: Request letter in Bank's standard format with FEMA declarations

signing.note: Signed by authorised signatory with company seal. Certification turnaround is T+1 per SBI Customer Guide.

channels.title: SBI YONO Business
steps: Log in to SBI YONO Business (CINB).
Upload the signed EDF documents and invoice proofs.
Confirm the digital services-EDF workflow with your home branch.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your SBI branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, the invoice XLSX spreadsheet, and invoice copies.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: SBI Branch / Trade Finance Desk
steps: Print the signed EDF (RBI Annex) and standard FEMA request letter.
Include service agreements, invoices, and proof of service.
Submit at your SBI home branch or designated Specialised Commercial Branch before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.
